description.narrative: The Government of Serbia plans to address compliance with the 2020 control measures under this HPMP through the following strategic objectives: (a) Strengthening policy instruments needed to reduce the supply and/or demand of HCFCs through the introduction of an import quota for HCFCs and HCFC based equipment and the improvement of an electronic licensing and reporting system to closely monitor the movement of ODS; (b) Implement measures in servicing sector that would include support to a recovery and reclamation facility for HCFC refrigerants, training for service technicians to enable better refrigeration practices, customs training to facilitate strict implementation of the HCFC regulations and public awareness to ensure a wider understanding of the need to phase-out HCFCs; (c) Conversion of the refrigeration manufacturing sector to non-HCFC technology through an investment project
